description: Source code for the DiscoveryInfoProvider class, which handles Greengrass discovery process including network connections, SSL setup, request sending, and response parsing.

classes.name: DiscoveryInfoProvider
classes.description: Class providing methods to perform Greengrass discovery, including network setup, SSL configuration, request handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the provider with optional SSL and connection parameters, sets up exception mapping.

methods.name: configureEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the host and port for the discovery request.

methods.name: configureTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for network operations.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Performs the discovery process for a given thing name, managing connection, request, and response.

methods.name: _create_tcp_connection
methods.description: Creates a TCP socket connection to the configured host and port.

methods.name: _create_ssl_connection
methods.description: Wraps the TCP socket with SSL, configuring SSL context based on port and Python version.

methods.name: _tls_match_hostname
methods.description: Performs hostname verification on the SSL certificate.

methods.name: _host_matches_cert
methods.description: Checks if the hostname matches the certificate's subject or SAN.

methods.name: _send_discovery_request
methods.description: Constructs and sends the HTTP discovery request over SSL socket.

methods.name: _receive_discovery_response
methods.description: Receives and parses the HTTP response, extracting status code and body.

methods.name: _receive_until
methods.description: Reads from socket until a condition is met or timeout occurs.

methods.name: _convert_to_int_py3
methods.description: Converts a byte to its integer representation, handling Python 3 differences.

methods.name: _got_enough_bytes
methods.description: Checks if the received bytes match the expected length.

methods.name: _got_two_crlfs
methods.description: Checks if the response contains two consecutive CRLF sequences, indicating end of headers.

methods.name: _handle_discovery_response_header
methods.description: Extracts HTTP status code and content length from response headers.

methods.name: _raise_on_timeout
methods.description: Raises exception if operation timed out.

methods.name: _raise_if_not_200
methods.description: Raises exception if HTTP status code is not 200, otherwise returns DiscoveryInfo.
